purpose: Test whether the exact P3-overlap 0-1 formulation accidentally falls into TU, bimodular, trimodular, or any fixed-Delta bounded-subdeterminant class. It does not: an explicit SAT family has exponentially growing square minors.

carrier_matrix.variables: One 0-1 variable x_o per literal occurrence o.
carrier_matrix.clause_rows: For each clause C, sum_{o in C} x_o = 1.
carrier_matrix.mixed_degree3_conflict_rows: For majority occurrences L,R and minority occurrence M of one Boolean variable, x_L+x_M <= 1 and x_M+x_R <= 1.
carrier_matrix.square_cubic_case: If there are n 3-clauses and n mixed degree-3 Boolean variables, there are 3n occurrence columns, n clause rows and 2n conflict rows, hence a 3n by 3n coefficient matrix Q_n.

local_elimination_lemma.statement: For each mixed degree-3 variable, the two conflict rows on columns (L,M,R) are [[1,1,0],[0,1,1]]. A unimodular column change with third basis vector (1,-1,1)^T turns these two rows into a rank-2 unit block plus one zero quotient column. Therefore |det Q| equals |det B|, where B is the clause-by-variable signed incidence matrix obtained by assigning +1 to both majority occurrences and -1 to the minority occurrence.
local_elimination_lemma.reason: The local conflict matrix has kernel span{(1,-1,1)} and has a 2x2 minor of determinant 1, so quotienting by the conflict rows introduces no determinant factor other than sign.

explicit_family.formula: For n>=4, indices modulo n, let C_i=(x_i OR x_{i+1} OR NOT x_{i+2}). Every variable occurs exactly three times: positively in C_i and C_{i-1}, negatively in C_{i-2}. The all-true assignment satisfies every clause.
explicit_family.signed_quotient_matrix: With P the cyclic shift permutation matrix, B_n = I + P - P^2 up to the harmless convention P versus P^{-1}.
explicit_family.determinant_formula: det(B_n)=1+(-1)^n(1-L_n), where L_n is the nth Lucas number (L_0=2,L_1=1,L_{n}=L_{n-1}+L_{n-2}).
closed_form_proof: The eigenvalues of P are the nth roots of unity zeta, so det(B_n)=product_{zeta^n=1}(1+zeta-zeta^2).
Let alpha,beta be the roots of z^2-z-1=0. Then 1+z-z^2=-(z-alpha)(z-beta), alpha*beta=-1, and alpha^n+beta^n=L_n.
Using product_{zeta^n=1}(zeta-alpha)=(-1)^n(alpha^n-1) and the same identity for beta gives det(B_n)=(-1)^n(alpha^n-1)(beta^n-1)=1+(-1)^n(1-L_n).
explicit_family.growth: For odd n, |det(B_n)|=L_n. For even n>=4, |det(B_n)|=L_n-2. Hence |det(Q_n)|=Theta(phi^n), phi=(1+sqrt(5))/2.

killed_shortcuts: Treat the exact P3-overlap carrier matrix as totally unimodular.
Invoke the strongly-polynomial bimodular IP theorem by claiming all minors are bounded by 2.
Invoke strict-3-modular or any fixed-Delta bounded-subdeterminant algorithm/conjecture as if the carrier had constant Delta.
Infer a constant denominator bound merely from the local P3/K2 structure.
not_killed: A global determinant/Pfaffian cancellation identity not based on bounded minors.

next_target.name: E8_PARITY_GROUP_EXTERIOR_ALL_OR_NONE_PROJECTION_V2_6
next_target.directive: Exploit determinant multilinearity before any exponential character enumeration: sum the local even-parity sign choices of each occurrence group in exterior algebra, reducing each degree-2/3 equality group to exactly two decomposable wedge states (all-constant versus all-perturbed). Then attack the remaining global product of rank-2 exterior tensors without materializing 2^n selector states.
